title: Self join — employee and manager (Sql)
description: Joining a table to itself with two aliases models hierarchies: each employee row pairs with its manager's row. LEFT JOIN keeps the top boss (no manager).
code:
SELECT e.name, m.name AS manager
FROM emp e LEFT JOIN emp m ON m.id = e.mgr;
how_it_works: Lab exercise: type the snippet into a fresh file, run it, and confirm the test outputs match. Then change one input and predict the result before running — Alias e scans employees, alias m looks up the manager id in the same table.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Recursive hierarchies need a recursive CTE, not repeated self joins.
use_cases: Org charts, category trees, linked lists in SQL.
